PR opened: https://github.com/FChecklist/compliance-tracker/pull/426

**Summary:** All 3 findings turned out to cite a stale doc (`CAPABILITY_COVERAGE.md`, written 2026-07-10, never updated after waves 165-170 wired 12 more engine categories). Real Chain Selector wiring was already 125/211 (59.2%), not 26/211 (12.3%) — Accounting/Payroll/Inventory/Income Tax are all wired now, not 0%. I found and fixed one genuine oversight (`loan_schedule_generator`/`amortization_engine`, dispatch-ready duplicates of `emi_calculator` that never got a Chain Selector leaf), rewrote the doc with accurate numbers (127/211 = 60.2% after the fix), and left the Custom Formula Builder unbuilt per its own finding's guidance (revisit only on real customer demand). Details are in `PROGRESS.md`; couldn't run `tsc`/`bun test` since this sandbox has no `bun`/`node_modules` installed, so I verified the diff manually (brace-balance check, minimal 2-key additive change reusing existing tested logic).
